summary: Candidate 'Conditional Trace Initialization' describes a conditional workflow that activates trace recording only when auto_start_session=False. This is semantically a child workflow of 'Initialize AgentOps Session with Manual Control' (which sets up the non-auto-start condition) and 'Decorate Workflow Function with Trace Metadata' (which provides the @trace decorator activation method). The candidate should merge into these two existing skills rather than persist as a separate micro_skill, as it represents a composite of their capabilities rather than a distinct new capability.
